MLS activar watchdogs.action: create or enable one isolated three-task watchdog group

MLS detener watchdogs.action: pause only the current chat watchdog group

MLS reactivar watchdogs.action: enable only the current chat watchdog group

MLS estado watchdogs.action: inspect only the current chat watchdog group

MLS detener watchdogs global.action: pause every task matching the canonical MLS Watchdog naming contract

MLS estado watchdogs global.action: inspect all canonical MLS watchdog groups

MLS watchdog group <GROUP ID>.action: explicitly establish a known logical group for recovery when local context is insufficient
